critique: Regression-based debunk of open-vocab rare-class claims is cheap and decisive either way. Exposure-vs-performance analyses exist for zero-shot classification, so the detection instantiation must cite and differentiate from them.
reason: Cheap inference-only falsification with field-level implications for OVD claims.

critique: Sampling-density vs feature-quality confound is real but the two-run design cannot isolate it cleanly (stride change alters features too). Resolution ablations are abundant in existing papers.
reason: Confounded design, low upside, well-trodden ablation space.

critique: Oracle-NMS decompositions were run by Hosang et al. and Parikh & Zitnick a decade ago, and crowd-NMS is a saturated subfield. The live question is whether NMS-free DETR-family models still miss in crowds, which would falsify the suppression-dominance story.
reason: Prior oracle analyses exist; mutate to NMS-free-era decomposition.

critique: Paste-in vs natural occlusion divergence is plausible and testable, but the finding would mostly caution robustness papers rather than change practice. Occlusion robustness protocols already vary widely, diluting the target.
reason: Moderate insight, limited downstream consequence.

critique: Decomposing temporal-aggregation gains is a decent diagnostic but video detection is a shrinking research market. The score-vs-box decomposition would be one figure in a stronger video-evaluation paper.
reason: Niche and shrinking area; fold into 0012-style stability work.

critique: Negation/composition failure is heavily documented for CLIP-family models (CREPE, SugarCrepe lineage); porting to detection is incremental. The bag-of-words control is nice but the headline result is predictable.
reason: Compositionality failures already established for VLM-based systems.

critique: If inter-annotator IoU on sub-16px objects is below the matching threshold, the entire small-object leaderboard stratum is measuring style, which is a field-changing claim at trivial cost. Must position against noise-aware-AP work (WACV 2025) that flags small objects as most noise-sensitive.
reason: Cheap, decisive, undermines an active benchmark stratum.

critique: AP-vs-count-error divergence is plausible and cheap, but crowd-counting literature already treats detection counting as a separate problem. The re-analysis is a good appendix, not a paper spine.
reason: Known task mismatch; limited new information.

critique: Tiling merge-policy accounting is engineering hygiene for aerial pipelines, already discussed in SAHI-style tooling papers. No general scientific claim survives.
reason: Engineering detail with existing tooling literature.

critique: Truncation-vs-occlusion error-type dissociation is a clean psychophysics-style hypothesis, but flags in KITTI/CrowdHuman are noisy (see 0274), which undercuts the measurement instrument. Would work better inside a larger error-taxonomy paper.
reason: Instrumentation (flags) too noisy to support the headline claim alone.

critique: If within-method prompt spread exceeds between-method deltas on ODinW, most OVD comparison tables are unreliable, a high-leverage negative result at inference-only cost. A 2026 arXiv note shows prompt variance is structured but only at toy scale, so the comparative variance-decomposition framing is still open.
reason: Inference-only, directly attacks how OVD papers claim wins.

critique: Temporal-stability metrics for video detection have been proposed repeatedly; the rank-decorrelation claim vs frame mAP is the only fresh part. Needs a deployment-cost argument to avoid being another unused metric proposal.
reason: Metric exists in variants; mutate to rank-decorrelation + downstream-cost validation.

critique: Object-interior vs context-ring masking on tiny objects is a crisp causal design with a counterintuitive prediction; context-reliance literature exists for classification but not size-stratified detection. Inpainting artifacts are the main validity threat and need matched-statistics controls.
reason: Simple counterintuitive causal test, cheap; protect.

critique: Amodal/modal convention mismatch is real but is a special case of label-convention shift, which 0208 attacks more generally with a better design. Keep the stronger general version.
reason: Subsumed by 0208 (label conventions as a domain).

critique: Density-conditioned calibration decay is plausible and cheap but detection-calibration literature (Kuppers et al., ECCV 2024 pitfalls paper) already conditions ECE on box variables. Marginal delta over existing conditioning analyses.
reason: Detection calibration conditioning already an active, crowded thread.

critique: Spatial-relation grounding failure is documented across VSR-style benchmarks and referring-expression analyses. The detection-specific two-object forced choice is a cleaner protocol but the conclusion is already community knowledge.
reason: Headline conclusion already established in adjacent benchmarks.

critique: IoU pathologies for 10:1 aspect ratios are analytically real but affect a tiny class population; oriented-box communities already moved to rotated IoU. Impact ceiling is low.
reason: Niche geometry issue with existing community workaround.

critique: Blur-stratified AP is a routine robustness slice; motion-blur corruption benchmarks already exist. Nothing here changes a decision.
reason: Routine stratification, no new decision value.

critique: Copy-paste-as-rebalancing is a clean mechanism question, but the Simple Copy-Paste paper and follow-ups already ablate frequency effects partially. Three training runs buy a modest clarification of a 2021 method.
reason: Mechanism partially ablated in original augmentation papers; aging target.

critique: Caption-leakage accounting plus invented-name probes gives a causal handle on what zero-shot detection means; the classification analog (exposure predicts zero-shot accuracy) makes the detection version urgent, not redundant. Pretraining-corpus access is the feasibility bottleneck.
reason: Directly tests the semantics of zero-shot claims; strong venue fit.

critique: Synonym-collision in class-wise NMS is a real deployment bug but reads as an engineering note. The embedding-clustered NMS fix is obvious once stated.
reason: Engineering bug report, not a research finding.

critique: Visible-fraction matching is sound methodology but the payoff (some occlusion-robustness orderings shrink) is a footnote-level correction. Better as a protocol inside a bigger occlusion-evaluation paper.
reason: Correction without consequence; no standalone paper.

critique: The stride-floor breakpoint is likely real but sampling-theory explanations of small-object failure appear in FPN/tiny-object literature already. Synthetic-set validity for real claims is the weak joint.
reason: Architecture-geometry floor largely community knowledge.

critique: Density reweighting changing rankings is a plausible but small-audience result confined to CrowdHuman-style benchmarks. One-figure finding.
reason: Single-benchmark reweighting exercise, low upside.

critique: Score-instability vs hard-miss decomposition is useful diagnostics but overlaps 0012/0190 which carry the same signal with clearer deployment framing. Consolidate.
reason: Redundant with 0012/0190 flicker line.

critique: Absent-class false-fire rate is a genuine deployment failure mode, but open-set overclaiming was quantified by Dhamija et al. (WACV 2020) and successors; the prompt-conditioned verification framing for OVD is the surviving delta. Merge with 0180 into one overclaiming benchmark.
reason: Open-set overclaiming known; mutate to OVD prompt-verification protocol merged with 0180.

critique: COCO-small vs aerial-small rank decorrelation is worth one table inside the benchmark-monoculture study (0260). Not a standalone contribution.
reason: Subsumed by 0260 cross-benchmark rank study.

critique: Occlusion-order probing is a cute representational question with no decision consequence; probe-based claims about 3D awareness are notoriously fragile. Correlation with crowded AP would be weak evidence either way.
reason: Probing study with fragile inference and low stakes.

critique: OC-SORT-era tracking already showed simple motion models beat learned re-association in many regimes, so the Kalman-coaster result is half-published. Occlusion-gap-stratified analysis adds little.
reason: Simple-motion-model superiority substantially established in tracking literature.

critique: Query-budget ceilings on DETR-family recall have been probed in crowd-detection papers, but a clean superlinearity law with inference-time query scaling is a tidy, cheap characterization. Frame it as capacity-law measurement, not discovery of the phenomenon.
reason: Phenomenon known qualitatively; mutate to quantitative capacity law.

critique: TIDE-style decomposition of upsampling modules is a routine ablation any method paper could include. No standalone claim.
reason: Routine error-decomposition ablation.

critique: The LVIS paper itself concedes per-category AP-rare is unstable and even runs bootstrap tests, so instability is known; what is missing is the audit showing which published pairwise long-tail claims dissolve under image-level bootstrap. Pure re-analysis, essentially risk-free, but must be framed as leaderboard forensics, not metric discovery.
reason: Instability known since LVIS 2019; mutate to significance audit of published claims.

critique: Amodal-completion pretraining is a reasonable causal hypothesis but requires paired pretraining runs with tight matching to be credible, and small amodal datasets (COCOA/KINS) cap the effect size. High risk of a null nobody learns from.
reason: Expensive causal test with weak power and modest stakes.

critique: Strong-single-frame-vs-temporal claims have circulated since image backbones jumped ahead of video-detection benchmarks. Compute-matching is the only new discipline, better executed in 0148.
reason: Duplicated by 0148 with a stronger design.

critique: Bitrate-stratified AP curves are useful applied documentation and cheap, but compression robustness appears in corruption benchmarks and codec-for-machines literature. Deployment guidance, not discovery.
reason: Applied documentation; partially covered by corruption/VCM literature.

critique: Ignore-region-induced miscalibration is a speculative mechanism with a fuzzy operationalization (density strata as proxy). The soft-label fix would need training-run evidence the budget doesn't justify.
reason: Fuzzy mechanism, weak measurement plan.

critique: Hierarchy-aware credit exists in semantic-similarity evaluation proposals and LVIS synonym handling; a ranking-flip demonstration is incremental. Fold into an OVD-evaluation-conventions paper with 0068/0142.
reason: Incremental scoring variant; consolidate elsewhere.

critique: The analytic IoU bound vs aspect ratio and angle is clean, certain to hold, and cheap, but oriented-detection communities already price this in by using rotated IoU. Publishable as a technical note at best.
reason: Correct but consequence-free for communities that already switched metrics.

critique: A saliency-bias score predicting camouflage failure is an interesting correlational story, but backbone-matched finetunes and a defensible bias probe make it heavier than it looks. COD is a small venue niche.
reason: Heavy instrumentation for a niche correlational claim.

critique: Episode-variance vs published-delta comparison for few-shot detection mirrors what killed naive few-shot classification claims, and detection has not had its reckoning. Near-certain to find undersized deltas; the risk is being seen as a known genre transplanted.
reason: Cheap replication-style audit with high probability of a decisive negative.

critique: AP-vs-deployment-operating-point criticism is the founding argument of the LRP metric (Oksuz et al. 2018), so the concept is published; the systematic rank-disagreement census across modern checkpoints and long-tail data is the surviving contribution. Frame as measurement of how often AP misleads, not as metric critique.
reason: LRP already made the argument; mutate to disagreement-census across model zoo.

critique: Deriving the matching threshold from measured inter-annotator IoU replaces a ritual constant with an evidence-based one, and ranking-flip demonstrations would be hard to ignore. Needs double-annotated subsets, which exist only partially; small re-annotation is the real cost.
reason: Turns an arbitrary convention into a measured quantity; cheap and sharp.

critique: Size-stratified human-human vs model-human Dice on LIDC-style data would establish where the medical segmentation benchmark signal ends; MICCAI's Metrics Reloaded flags small-structure Dice instability but does not run this census. Strong MICCAI/D&B fit with public multi-annotator data.
reason: Decisive medical-eval claim on existing multi-annotator data.

critique: 101-point interpolation bias in low-support regimes is a real implementation artifact but is the kind of appendix detail pycocotools issues threads already document. One table inside 0311's uncertainty budget.
reason: Implementation footnote; absorb into metrology budget (0311).

critique: Macro-vs-micro averaging flips are certain to occur and cheap to show, but averaging-convention critique is well-worn in long-tail papers. Better as one axis of the multi-metric honesty study (0066).
reason: Known convention sensitivity; consolidate into 0066.

critique: Noise-aware AP bounds (WACV 2025), Sama-COCO, and COCO-ReM already established that annotation noise moves AP by ranking-relevant amounts, so the discovery claim is gone; the surviving wedge is a full Monte-Carlo noise-propagation pipeline that outputs per-comparison significance verdicts for published SOTA increments. Execute as forensic audit of specific claims or it will be reviewed as a rediscovery.
reason: Prior work close but the claim-level significance audit remains open; mutated framing required.

critique: Boundary IoU's own paper characterizes when it diverges from Mask IoU. An adoption analysis adds sociology, not science.
reason: Original metric paper already covers the divergence analysis.

critique: Cross-model score incomparability is implicitly known (every deployment recalibrates) and detection-calibration papers cover the machinery. The naive-vs-calibrated-threshold comparison flip is a useful PSA but thin.
reason: Known in practice; calibration literature covers the fix.

critique: AP's rewarding of low-confidence hedging is published: Dave et al. (2021) demonstrated gameable AP on LVIS and 'Seeing without Looking' (CVPR 2020) built an AP-maximizing rescorer. The deployment-review-cost framing is new packaging only.
reason: Gameability published; mutate toward the COCO-specific hedging cost curve inside 0311 or drop.

critique: Cross-implementation AP diffs on identical prediction files are anecdotally known but never systematically cataloged with per-class attribution; this is a zero-risk software-forensics study every practitioner would cite. Its ceiling is a strong D&B/reproducibility-track paper, not a main-track discovery.
reason: Cheap, certain yield; mutate into 0311 metrology budget as the implementation-variance component.

critique: Dice-vs-boundary-F1 disagreement prediction from shape complexity is neat but Metrics Reloaded already guides metric choice by shape properties. Marginal.
reason: Metric-selection guidance already codified in Metrics Reloaded.

critique: PQ-rare bootstrap instability is the panoptic clone of 0032 with a smaller audience. Do 0032 first; cite this as corollary.
reason: Corollary of 0032 with smaller audience.

critique: Propriety violation of AP is effectively published: Dave et al. (2021) constructed the information-free re-ranking exploit and probabilistic-detection work (ECCV 2022) formalized proper scoring rules for detection. Only a COCO-specific magnitude table remains, which is not a paper.
reason: Core result published (LVIS gameability + proper-scoring-rule formalization).

critique: Finding/naming/outlining axes overlap TIDE's error types and LRP's components, so the decomposition itself is not new; the per-axis leaderboard with no-model-dominates evidence is the fresh artifact. Position as leaderboard redesign, expect metric-fatigue pushback.
reason: Decomposition known; mutate to multi-axis leaderboard artifact with dominance analysis.

critique: A fresh protocol-matched COCO test set is the detection version of ImageNetV2 and would settle a decade of adaptive-overfitting speculation with one artifact; nobody has done it because annotation is expensive and unglamorous. High cost and protocol-fidelity risk, but the artifact value is field-wide and durable.
reason: High-cost high-reward; the single most informative missing artifact in detection evaluation. Protect.

critique: Continuous size-AP curves revealing bucket-boundary gaming is a good diagnostic figure but not a standalone paper. Absorb into 0074's threshold-schedule work.
reason: Diagnostic figure; consolidate with 0074.

critique: That high-confidence FPs are often unlabeled true objects is documented (TIDE's misannotation analysis, missing-annotation literature, Sama-COCO); the unproven, high-value part is the differential claim that stronger detectors pay a larger tax, inverting frontier rankings. The 500-per-model verification design directly tests the inversion and is cheap.
reason: Known phenomenon, unknown differential effect on rankings; cheap decisive design.

critique: GT dedup policy sensitivity is real (COCO-ReM found 410 near-duplicate pairs) but affects few classes. Appendix material for 0311.
reason: Small-population artifact; absorb into metrology budget.

critique: Slice-vs-volume aggregation pitfalls are explicitly covered by Metrics Reloaded and challenge-design literature (BIAS guidelines). The heavy-tail predictability angle is a minor addition.
reason: Aggregation pitfall already codified in MICCAI metrics guidance.

critique: The ECCV 2024 calibration-pitfalls paper already shows D-ECE variants mislead, weakening the discovery claim; grounding detector selection in explicit decision costs is the remaining contribution and is what deployment actually needs. Must differentiate sharply from LaECE/LaACE line.
reason: ECE-variant disagreement published; mutate to decision-cost-grounded selection protocol.

critique: mAP's monotone-invariance blindness is textbook; risk-coverage divergence between mAP-matched pairs is a nice demonstration but 0182/0339 carry the same message. Consolidate.
reason: Redundant with 0339/0182 confidence-information line.

critique: The AR-predicts-AP folk rule dates to proposal-era detection and is likely broken for query-based models; an 8-model correlation table falsifies it in days. Cheap-to-falsify hygiene work with modest but real citational value.
reason: Protect as cheap folk-rule falsification; fold into a folk-rules omnibus paper.

critique: Cost-sensitive re-scoring depends entirely on the credibility of the cost matrix, and AV-safety taxonomies do not map cleanly to per-confusion costs. nuScenes NDS and planner-centric metrics already occupy this ground.
reason: Cost-matrix credibility problem; adjacent metrics exist.

critique: Image-level vs instance-level bootstrap choice silently changes significance verdicts and nobody has standardized it for detection; this is the statistical foundation 0070/0302 need. Certain yield, methodological audience.
reason: Foundational statistics piece for every detection significance claim.

critique: A statistical-practice census of 200 detection papers plus re-tests of 20 claims is the field-level indictment that NLP and RL already went through; detection has escaped it. Reading labor is the real cost; results are near-guaranteed to be damning.
reason: Meta-science with guaranteed signal and field-level consequence.

critique: Pareto-incomparability of consecutive SOTA claims reframes progress narratives with pure re-analysis; related multi-metric critiques exist but the historical-chain audit is fresh. Axis selection will be attacked as arbitrary, so preregister the axes.
reason: Keep the audit, harden axis selection; merge with 0303 external-validity line.

critique: HOTA's own literature discusses threshold sensitivity, and TrackEval standardization already reduced this. Mid-table reordering is a weak headline.
reason: Tracking-metrics community already litigating this.

critique: Synonym-aware matching favoring generative-vocabulary models is plausible and cheap but reads as an evaluation-convention proposal without a forcing function. Fold with 0037/0142 into one OVD-evaluation-conventions study.
reason: Consolidate; no standalone weight.

critique: Box-vs-mask IoU divergence for articulated categories is unsurprising and consequence-light. One figure, not a paper.
reason: Expected result, low stakes.

critique: Minimum-detectable-effect lookup tables per benchmark would give reviewers a hard number to reject underpowered claims with; nothing similar exists for detection. Bootstrap-only, near-zero risk, durable citation artifact.
reason: Zero-risk, field-infrastructure deliverable; merge with 0302.

critique: Whether SOTA now exceeds the human-human agreement ceiling decides whether COCO-style benchmarks still measure model quality at all; adjacent evidence (COCO-ReM, small-object noise) suggests yes in strata. Needs careful annotator protocol to avoid measuring cheap-label noise instead of the ceiling.
reason: Benchmark-epistemology question with direct evidence design; pairs with 0338.

critique: Post-processing standardization shrinking gaps is plausible and cheap, but reads as one more confound audit among 0282/0285/0292. Consolidate into the compute/tuning-fairness program.
reason: Absorbed by the tuning-fairness cluster (0285/0292).

critique: Empty-case Dice conventions are explicitly treated in Metrics Reloaded and challenge guidelines; the cross-paper invalidity survey is a small addition. Marginal delta on codified knowledge.
reason: Convention pitfall already codified in Metrics Reloaded.

critique: A pixel-tolerance-equalized IoU ladder is a principled correction to size-dependent localization weighting, related to tiny-object metrics (DotD, NWD) but more general. Re-scoring only; the ranking-change result would matter to small-object subcommunities.
reason: Merge with 0056's continuous size curves into one size-fairness evaluation paper.

critique: Server-vs-local discrepancies are operational trivia gated by submission quotas. No scientific claim.
reason: Operational audit, not research.

critique: Annotation-style drift across dataset versions is real (COCO-ReM demonstrates version-dependent scoring) but the cross-version audit is a special case of 0298's provenance forensics and 0208's convention shift. Consolidate.
reason: Subsumed by 0298 + 0208.

critique: Minimum-support reporting rules are a policy proposal whose empirical backbone is 0032; on its own it is an editorial. Merge.
reason: Policy corollary of 0032.

critique: Whether marginal AP still buys downstream utility is the question that decides if detection SOTA-chasing matters; AV planner-centric metric papers gesture here but no fixed-pipeline saturation curve exists across a 10-AP-point detector ladder. Pipeline choice will be attacked as arbitrary, so use two dissimilar pipelines.
reason: Utility-saturation curve is the field's missing cost-benefit evidence.

critique: PDQ was proven not to be a proper scoring rule (ECCV 2022) which answers most of the autopsy question already. Tooling-friction sociology is not testable at paper strength.
reason: Core question resolved by proper-scoring-rule literature.

critique: Recovering annotator-batch signatures from GT box statistics and showing per-stratum AP differences would prove AP partially measures style-matching, a genuinely fresh intra-dataset angle beyond Sama-COCO's inter-dataset comparison. Risk: style clusters may be too weak to separate from content confounds.
reason: Novel measurable mechanism of benchmark noise; cheap. Protect against average-score death.

critique: Battle of the Backbones (NeurIPS 2023 D&B) reports strong cross-task rank correlation (rho>0.8), directly contradicting the hypothesis at coarse grain, and Kornblith 2019 settled the classification case; the untested wedge is compute-matched finetunes and within-family analysis at fixed scale where correlations may collapse. Only viable as a targeted refutation/refinement of BoB.
reason: BoB collision; mutate to within-family compute-matched decorrelation test.

critique: SAM domain-failure mapping is one of the most published topics of 2023-24 (medical multi-domain studies, concealed-scene studies, 'Segment Anything Is Not Always Perfect', multiple surveys and meta-analyses); an atlas would be a literature review with extra inference. The only opening is a predictive, preregistered failure model validated on held-out unseen domains, and even that fights SAM-2-era churn.
reason: Atlas exists piecewise; mutate to validated quantitative failure-prediction law or drop.

critique: Non-monotonic data-value curves under noise are predicted by label-noise theory and partially observed in web-scale training studies. The detection-specific inflection measurement is real but training-heavy for a confirmatory result.
reason: Confirms theory at nontrivial training cost.

critique: Cost-matched mask-vs-box supervision inverts the folklore only if the cost model is credible, and annotation-cost ratios vary wildly across vendors. Sensitive to one number nobody agrees on.
reason: Conclusion hostage to contested cost ratio.

critique: Single-scale-suffices claims surface whenever backbones improve; the null is plausible but recipe-dependent and dated fast. Low durability.
reason: Recipe-dependent null with short shelf life.

critique: Frozen-foundation-backbone detection is already demonstrated (DINOv2 frozen evaluations, ViTDet-era adapter studies) including shift robustness. Largely published.
reason: Frozen-backbone competitiveness already in foundation-model reports.

critique: Overfitting-onset mapping under 3x schedules is a costly confirmation of known schedule lore (long-schedule COCO runs are documented in model zoos). Expensive, low surprise.
reason: High compute for known-shape curve.

critique: Randomization-vs-realism conditioned on target knowledge is the domain-randomization literature's central axis, explored since Tobin 2017 across many rendering studies. The knowledge-value quantification is a nice frame but the space is picked over.
reason: Core DR trade-off heavily explored.

critique: Classes whose AP falls as resolution rises would be a genuinely surprising, cheap, per-class scaling anomaly with a testable context-dependence predictor. Even if the effect is small it exposes a blind assumption (resolution monotonicity) nobody checks.
reason: Protect as cheap counterintuitive probe; merge into a resolution-causality package with 0340.

critique: Image-vs-video pretraining comparisons exist across video-understanding literature and matched-compute claims are hard to enforce with public checkpoints. Weak instrument for the question.
reason: Uncontrollable confounds with public checkpoints.

critique: Decontaminated SSL-vs-supervised comparisons have been attempted repeatedly (matched-data studies in the SimCLR/MoCo era and BoB) with the recipe-confound point already made. Pretraining runs are expensive for an incremental clarification.
reason: Expensive; core confound already documented.

critique: Sign-flipping augmentation effects across families is plausible but nine training runs buy a fragmentary interaction map. Low generality per FLOP.
reason: Interaction study with poor generality-per-compute.

critique: Small-batch detection recipes with GN were established around 2018-2020 (GroupNorm paper itself trained detection at batch 1-2). Retired question.
reason: Answered by GroupNorm-era work.

critique: EMA failure-regime mapping is useful tuning lore but produces a recipe table, not a scientific claim. Workshop material.
reason: Tuning lore, not research.

critique: Mosaic-as-scale-jitter is a clean decomposition of a cargo-cult trick, but YOLO-lineage ablations have partially chipped at it. Three runs for a mechanism note.
reason: Partial ablations exist; modest ceiling.

critique: Deformable-attention necessity at modern scale is a moving target; any null will be attributed to recipe specifics. Expensive and perishable.
reason: Perishable architecture null.

critique: Depth-from-frozen-features probing has been done for many backbone families in emergent-property studies. Detector-specific probing adds little.
reason: Probing literature already covers this.

critique: Label-smoothing-vs-NMS interaction is a plausible micro-mechanism but two training runs on a niche interaction is a workshop poster. Low ceiling.
reason: Micro-mechanism, low stakes.

critique: COCO-ReM, Sama-COCO and the label-error literature already show large annotation problems, but none ran an adjudicated provenance census of a SOTA model's residual errors with the specific claim 'majority are not model failures'. The census framing survives if it quantifies provenance shares with human adjudication rather than re-annotation quality deltas.
reason: Crowded space; mutate to adjudicated provenance-share census (merge with 0326).

critique: Transformer-vs-CNN robustness at matched pretraining was litigated for classification (Bhojanapalli 2021; Pinto 2022 'impartial take') with the same conclusion this idea predicts. Detection replication is expensive confirmation.
reason: Classification verdict likely transfers; costly to confirm.

critique: Robustness loss under detection distillation is a deployment-relevant blind spot; classification hints exist but student fleets in industry make the detection case consequential. Needs corruption plus real-shift suites to avoid synthetic-only criticism (see 0178).
reason: Keep hypothesis, tie to real-shift evaluation; moderate prior work in classification.

critique: TTA harming tails and calibration is a cheap inference-only check of a universally-applied trick; scattered anecdotes but no stratified audit exists. Small but certain contribution.
reason: Fold into a tricks-under-audit omnibus (with 0292); cheap certain yield.

critique: Frozen-BN finetuning behavior is settled folklore with public evidence in every framework's model zoo configs. Nothing to learn.
reason: Settled practice.

critique: Label-efficiency exponents vs scale for detection is a real scaling question but twelve training runs at meaningful scale is beyond a cheap study, and scaling-law literature moves fast. Better done inside an industrial lab.
reason: Underpowered at academic budget.

critique: Resolution-mismatch costs with proper positional-embedding interpolation are documented across ViT-era papers. Retired.
reason: Answered in ViT adaptation literature.

critique: Whether open-vocab generations have narrowed the gap to compute-matched closed-set specialists on fixed vocabularies is a real deployment question scattered across papers but never tracked across generations. The trend claim (gap not shrinking) is falsifiable and useful either way.
reason: Keep core question; tighten to generation-over-generation gap tracking.

critique: Systematic-vs-random pseudo-label error ceilings are studied in distillation and semi-supervised theory; the SAM-specific plateau measurement is useful engineering guidance. Not a strong scientific wedge.
reason: Engineering guidance; theory already predicts the shape.

critique: VLM benchmark-vs-grounding dissociation is being actively mapped by the VLM evaluation community (grounding-specific benchmarks proliferating). Scale-controlled correlation is a nice touch but the window is closing fast.
reason: Racing a fast-moving VLM-eval literature.

critique: Hard-negative mining on top of focal loss is a 2019-era question with low current relevance. Retired.
reason: Dated question.

critique: Budget-matched MTL interference was made famous by Standley/Fifty et al.; a detection-specific replication mostly confirms. Kill unless a surprising synergy is expected, which it is not.
reason: MTL interference literature covers the claim.

critique: FLOP-matched resolution-vs-width for small objects is a legitimate allocation question but nine runs on VisDrone yields a local answer that scaling papers will supersede. Low durability.
reason: Local answer, short shelf life.

critique: Equivariance-from-crops is a fun mechanistic question but sub-stride translation analysis (Zhang's anti-aliasing line) already maps CNN translation behavior. Low stakes.
reason: Anti-aliasing literature covers the mechanism.

critique: Texture-vs-geometry decomposition of syn2real is half-answered by stylization studies (Geirhos-lineage) applied to detection UDA. The residual is a magnitude estimate, not a new mechanism.
reason: Stylization-transfer studies already bound the texture share.

critique: Effective-robustness inheritance through detection heads is a good question (classification effective-robustness is mapped, detection is not), but requires careful matched finetunes and shifted detection sets that barely exist. Instrumentation gap makes it heavier than it looks.
reason: Missing shifted-detection instrumentation; heavy for the return.

critique: An annotation quality-vs-quantity exchange rate with a decision threshold from annotator-agreement statistics would directly steer labeling budgets industry-wide; existing label-noise studies degrade synthetically but never derive the a-priori decision rule. Simulated-degradation validity is the main reviewer attack; anchor noise rates in measured annotator data.
reason: Practical decision rule with broad consequence; strong D&B fit.

critique: Object-removal interventions exist for classification/segmentation ('Not Using the Car to See the Sidewalk') and removed-object hallucination is now benchmarked for LVLMs (NAACL 2025), so the phenomenon class is published; the detector-specific ghost-rate metric with class-context correlation is the remaining wedge. Inpainting-artifact controls decide credibility.
reason: Surviving wedge: detector ghost-rate benchmark; execute with strict artifact controls.

critique: Compression-fingerprint matching raising AP is a provocative contamination-adjacent claim but the proposed provenance attribution is weakly identified. High risk of uninterpretable small effects.
reason: Weak identification, likely inconclusive.

critique: Random-feature baselines were mapped in the frozen-random-network literature years ago. Detection version adds a data point, not an idea.
reason: Known random-feature story.

critique: Label-free AP estimation from transform-stability would give deployment monitoring for free; AutoEval and agreement-based accuracy prediction exist for classification, so the detection port must beat those baselines, not just correlate. If the 0.8 correlation holds across domains this is widely used.
reason: High-utility label-free evaluation; classification priors make it plausible but unclaimed for detection.

critique: Natural-frequency training beating balanced training even on balanced tests would contradict the default assumption of the entire rebalancing literature via a context-information mechanism. Two training runs; if it replicates across two datasets it rewrites long-tail baselines.
reason: Protect: counterintuitive with mechanism; needs multi-dataset replication design.

critique: Long-range detection manipulation through suppression interactions is the mechanism behind published NMS-targeting attacks (Daedalus-style). The ablation isolating NMS as the carrier is a footnote to that literature.
reason: NMS-mediated attacks already published.

critique: Train-test and pretraining-test contamination censuses transformed classification (CIFAR/ImageNet duplicate studies) and LLM evaluation, but detection benchmarks have never been audited; the flagged-vs-clean AP comparison makes it causal, not just descriptive. Web-crawl-to-test auditing is the hard, valuable part.
reason: Unaudited contamination in detection; certain-yield census with per-image causal check.

critique: Double descent in dense prediction is a curiosity question requiring an interpolation-regime width ladder that COCO-scale detection resists. Expensive with a good chance of ambiguous curves.
reason: Costly curiosity with high ambiguity risk.

critique: Vocabulary-order sensitivity is an unphysical degree of freedom nobody reports; a permutation test across three architectures takes days and any nonzero effect indicts evaluation practice. Tiny paper but a perfect cheap falsification.
reason: Protect as cheap-to-falsify; publish inside OVD-evaluation-conventions bundle (0011/0142).

critique: Spectral analysis of box-coordinate residuals for stride harmonics is an original measurement, and a free post-hoc de-quantization gain for small objects would be immediately adopted. Risk is that modern reference-point mechanisms already smear the grid, yielding a null; even the null is informative about decoder geometry.
reason: Original cheap measurement with a potential free improvement; protect.

critique: Rotation-augmentation residual anisotropy is predictable and low-stakes. One figure.
reason: Predictable, low stakes.

critique: Robustness-optimal-vs-accuracy-optimal checkpoints along training have been reported for classification robustness curves. Detection replication is cheap but confirmatory.
reason: Confirmatory of known training-dynamics results.

critique: Cross-seed loss variance as a mislabel detector connects data-pruning metrics to annotation-error discovery with a testable AP gain from deletion; pruning literature (EL2N/forgetting) is close but targets efficiency, not error removal. The AP-gain-from-deletion claim is the risky, interesting part.
reason: Reframe as annotation-error mining vs pruning baselines; merge with 0129.

critique: Ensemble-GT disagreement mining is Confident-Learning-for-detection, and a 2025 label-error-detection framework already benchmarks detection error mining, so novelty is thin; the adjudicated 70%-precision claim and a released cleaned-GT artifact are the salvage. Execute as artifact paper, not method paper.
reason: Method space occupied; mutate to adjudicated artifact + benchmark of miners (merge 0128).

critique: White-balance class-flips are a plausible micro-robustness effect covered conceptually by color-corruption suites. Low stakes.
reason: Corruption benchmarks cover the phenomenon class.

critique: Box-jitter-for-calibration is a plausible free-lunch trick but four training runs for a micro-improvement is method-paper territory the batch explicitly avoids. Off-mission.
reason: Micro-method, off the evaluation-science mission.

critique: Batch-composition effects beyond seed noise would be hard to isolate from data-order effects and likely tiny. Weak power, weak stakes.
reason: Likely tiny effect, weak identification.

critique: Typographic attacks are canonical for CLIP and were recently extended to VLMs, so scene-text hijacking of OVD detectors is a predictable transfer, but the localization-on-text signature and scrambled-letter controls give it detection-specific teeth. Safety framing (sign vandalism) raises its ceiling.
reason: Phenomenon expected from CLIP lineage; mutate to localization-signature + physical-feasibility study.

critique: Transfer-asymmetry prediction from label-convention divergence is a nice regression but eight cross-trainings support only weak causal claims. 0208 tests the same mechanism with a cleaner intervention.
reason: Mechanism better identified by 0208's dual-annotation design.

critique: Blob-substitution preserving partner-class detections (and sometimes labeling the blob itself) is the cleanest co-occurrence-over-appearance demonstration proposed for detectors, going beyond Elephant-in-the-Room's transplant design with a shape-controlled intervention. Cheap, vivid, and quantifiable per class pair.
reason: Simple counterintuitive causal probe; protect. Absorbs 0222/0268.

critique: Seed-variance components exist for classification (Picard; Bouthillier's MLSys 2021 variance accounting) but detection has no published variance decomposition, and the direct comparison against a curated list of published year-over-year deltas is the killer table. Thirty runs is the batch's most defensible large compute spend because every future detection paper must cite the resulting sigma.
reason: Foundational missing number for the field; survives prior-work attack (classification-only precedents).

critique: Resize-kernel sensitivity (antialias flags, PIL-vs-OpenCV) is documented in framework migration notes and reproducibility threads; a systematic AP-small quantification is useful but confirms practitioner knowledge. Fold into 0311's implementation-variance component.
reason: Documented practitioner knowledge; absorb into metrology budget.

critique: Dataset classification from patches is the Torralba-Efros 2011 'Name That Dataset' result, revived and confirmed at scale by Liu & He (2024). Probing detector features for the fingerprint adds a minor twist to a settled phenomenon.
reason: Settled by Name-That-Dataset lineage.

critique: Post-hoc candidate-set re-scoring overlaps 'Seeing without Looking' (CVPR 2020) and soft-NMS variants, but those target AP, not calibration; recovering calibration information NMS destroys is the unclaimed half. Tie to 0158's pre/post-NMS calibration finding for one coherent paper.
reason: AP half is published; mutate to calibration-information recovery, merge with 0158.

critique: Partial-freezing regularization curves are finetuning lore explored across transfer-learning studies. Recipe table, not science.
reason: Transfer-learning lore.

critique: Padding/border effects on CNN detections were characterized by Kayhan & van Gemert (CVPR 2020) and the position-information literature. The inference-time padding swap is a minor extension.
reason: Border-effect literature already exists.

critique: Synonym-name AP instability is the per-name special case of 0011's prompt-variance audit. Merge; not independently publishable.
reason: Subsumed by 0011.

critique: Mirror-asymmetry from photographer bias is cute but flip-TTA ubiquity makes deployed impact near zero. Trivia.
reason: Negligible practical consequence.

critique: Precision-sensitivity gradients with object size are plausible numerical trivia; six runs for an infrastructure footnote. Absorb any signal into 0282/0311.
reason: Infrastructure footnote.

critique: Vocabulary-size interference curves (fixed targets, growing distractor list) measure a real scaling property of OVD deployment that scattered ablations touch but never characterize as decay laws across architectures. Inference-only and immediately actionable for anyone shipping large vocabularies.
reason: Cheap characterization of an OVD scaling law; deployment-relevant.

critique: Sanity-check failures (Adebayo) have been replicated across explanation families for years; running them on detection transformers is a predictable port. The deletion metric overlaps 0173/0307.
reason: Predictable port of settled sanity-check results.

critique: Detection-transfer saturation with pretraining-corpus size is contested territory (scaling-law and limits-of-pretraining papers disagree), and nested public checkpoint families confound data with recipe. Weak identification for a big claim.
reason: Confounded instrument for a heavily contested claim.

critique: An equal-FLOP frame-detector-plus-smoother vs video-architecture showdown would either retire a subfield or validate it, and nobody has run it honestly compute-matched. Tuning fairness for the simple pipeline is the crux; preregister the budget.
reason: Decisive equal-compute negative-result candidate for video detection.

critique: Compute-matched single-big-model vs ensembles/MC-dropout for detection UQ is the deployment question every safety team asks; classification hints (Ovadia et al.) exist but detection risk-coverage accounting does not. A negative result here reprices an entire UQ subliterature.
reason: High-stakes compute-matched UQ audit, unclaimed for detection.

critique: The 50-labeled-images-vs-UDA comparison is devastating if true and trivially cheap to run against published UDA numbers; semi-supervised baselines have embarrassed UDA in classification before. Label-budget honesty (annotator-day accounting) makes the claim concrete and hard to dodge.
reason: Cheap kill-shot on a large subfield; high citation value either way.

critique: A preregistered curriculum null for detection is clean science but curriculum learning already has broad null/mixed meta-analyses in supervised learning. Nine runs to confirm a widely suspected null.
reason: Null already widely suspected and partially documented.

critique: Learned-augmentation transfer failure is consistent with post-AutoAugment analyses (RandAugment's own motivation). Eight runs for a known-direction result.
reason: Direction already established by RandAugment lineage.

critique: Neck-variant nulls under equal tuning would be useful but is one instance of the general tuning-budget-asymmetry claim that 0285 tests across whole papers. Do the general version.
reason: Instance of 0285's general design.

critique: Honest threshold transfer is a specific, checkable leakage mechanism in semi-supervised detection that reviewers of those papers never police; halving of published gains is a concrete falsifiable prediction. Small run set; the threat is authors claiming threshold robustness in rebuttal, so test several methods.
reason: Concrete leakage audit with quantified prediction; cheap.

critique: Crowded-scene auto-label ceilings are the 0107 plateau story on harder data. Merge or drop.
reason: Duplicate of 0107 mechanism.

critique: Tuned-baseline-erases-synthetic-pretraining is another instance of the baseline-decay thesis (0283/0285) applied to one subfield. The general audits dominate it.
reason: Instance of the stale-baseline program.

critique: Tail-loss under distillation is plausible and deployment-relevant but is the long-tail slice of 0101's robustness-loss audit. One distillation-cost paper should carry both.
reason: Merge into 0101 distillation-cost audit.

critique: Detection-calibration literature is dense (Kuppers 2020; ECCV 2024 pitfalls paper tailors post-hoc calibrators and fixes evaluation), and practitioners already fit calibrators on final outputs, so the pre/post-NMS selection-bias localization must be positioned as the mechanism explaining known pitfalls rather than a new phenomenon. Analysis-only and certain to produce a clean answer either way.
reason: Crisp mechanism question, zero compute; survives as the explanatory piece of the calibration-pitfalls story.

critique: Classification AL got its honest-evaluation reckoning (Munjal et al.; DISTIL analyses) but detection AL has only ALBench at small batches on VOC, leaving the realistic-batch-size claim genuinely open. A multi-codebase preregistered null at 5k-image batches would redirect labeling budgets industry-wide.
reason: Open replication gap with direct budget consequences; survives attack.

critique: 'Evaluating WSOL Right' (Choe et al., CVPR 2020) already showed CAM-era methods fail against tuned baselines under a fair protocol. This is that paper again.
reason: Done by Choe et al. 2020.

critique: TTA collapse under long continual shift is documented for classification (CoTTA-era stability analyses); the detection port is plausible and useful but confirmatory. Predictable-onset modeling is the only fresh element.
reason: Classification collapse results likely transfer; confirmatory.

critique: Adversarial-training-vs-corruption-augmentation under deployment threat models is a sensible accounting but the adversarial-robustness community has litigated the clean-robust trade extensively. Detection twist is small.
reason: Well-litigated trade-off, small twist.

critique: Vocabulary-scaling negative transfer inside OVD training is interesting but requires controlled retraining of open-vocab models, which is heavy; the inference-side interference (0145) captures the deployable half cheaply. Do 0145 first.
reason: Training-side version dominated by cheap inference-side 0145.

critique: Metric-polish-vs-measurement-truth for refinement modules needs calibrated physical GT that barely exists publicly. Instrumentation-limited.
reason: No public physical-truth instrumentation.

critique: GT-depth-vs-estimated-depth degradation is a known failure pattern reported in depth-aware detection ablations. Confirmation with public models.
reason: Known ablation pattern.

critique: TFA (ICML 2020) already showed simple finetuning beats meta-learning FSOD, so the concept is published; but post-2020 FSOD methods claim to beat TFA, and nobody has re-armed the finetuning baseline with modern augmentation and compute matching against them. The surviving claim is that the 2020 lesson was forgotten, which 0040's variance result would compound.
reason: TFA precedent; mutate to re-armed baseline vs post-TFA methods, jointly with 0040.

critique: Positional-encoding nulls at one scale are expensive and perishable. Low value per FLOP.
reason: Expensive perishable null.

critique: Reweighting-equals-resampling equivalences have been reported in long-tail comparisons under shared recipes (equalization-loss follow-ups). Eight runs for a mostly-known equivalence.
reason: Equivalence largely documented in long-tail re-benchmarks.

critique: Oliver et al. (NeurIPS 2018) established the OOD-unlabeled-pool failure for classification SSL and it is standard caveat knowledge; a detection replication mostly re-confirms with modern methods. Useful hygiene, weak novelty.
reason: Classification result canonical; detection port confirmatory.

critique: Soup-failure localization to matching-dependent heads is a tidy mechanistic story and cheap, but model-soup papers already note detection heads misbehave. Backbone-only-soup salvage is a known workaround.
reason: Mechanism noted in soup literature.

critique: NAS-transfer failure was documented by the NAS-evaluation-is-hard literature. Detection instance adds nothing structural.
reason: NAS-evaluation literature covers it.

critique: Region-contrastive-vs-supervised at matched compute was effectively run during the dense-SSL wave with mixed results. Pretraining runs are too expensive to relitigate.
reason: Relitigation of dense-SSL wave at pretraining cost.

critique: Deletion-test failures replicate classification XAI results; the detection twist (within-box deletion) is minor. 0307's intervention benchmark is the better home.
reason: Fold into 0307; classification XAI precedents.

critique: Progressive-resizing nulls are recipe trivia. No audience.
reason: Recipe trivia.

critique: Auxiliary-task-vs-more-data budget conversion is the 0110 MTL-interference question restated. Merge and kill.
reason: Duplicate of 0110; both dominated by existing MTL accounting.

critique: Class-conditional calibration structure is within reach of existing detection-calibration papers that already fit per-class calibrators (ECCV 2024 baselines do class-wise thresholds). Incremental.
reason: Class-wise calibration already in current baselines.

critique: Confidence-should-predict-IoU is the founding intuition of IoU-Net, GFL, and VarifocalNet on the method side and LaECE on the metric side, so both halves exist; the unclaimed part is the model-zoo-wide audit quantifying how little confidence explains IoU variance and what that costs downstream filters. Frame as measurement, not method.
reason: Method and metric halves published; mutate to zoo-wide variance-explained audit.

critique: Whether synthetic corruption rankings predict real degraded-capture rankings is the validity question under every robustness paper, and paired-camera evidence does not exist for detection. Capture effort is nontrivial but modest, and either outcome reprices corruption benchmarks.
reason: Falsifies or validates the field's robustness instrument; protect the capture budget.

critique: Fusion-rule-as-calibration-decision is a reasonable reframe but ensemble fusion (WBF etc.) is engineering territory with active tooling. Small conceptual delta.
reason: Tooling-level insight.

critique: Open-set overclaiming was established by Dhamija et al. (WACV 2020) and the OSOD benchmark wave; the surviving claims are the AP-decorrelation (overclaiming as an independent model axis) and modern OVD coverage. Merge with 0026 into one overclaiming-audit paper with a maintained leaderboard.
reason: Phenomenon published; mutate to independent-axis audit across modern models (merge 0026).

critique: Confidence non-monotonicity under progressive occlusion (including confidence that rises as objects hide) is a genuinely odd, cheap, controlled measurement nobody reports. Small paper but a memorable sanity-violation result; occluder realism is the main confound to control.
reason: Protect as cheap sanity-violation probe; bundle with 0181-style UQ audits (0185).

critique: Risk-coverage reporting for detection is a sound proposal but selective-prediction framing has been ported to detection in recent UQ papers. The oracle-gap accounting is a modest addition.
reason: Selective-prediction port already underway in UQ literature.

critique: Loss-family dose-response to label noise is mapped in noisy-detection literature (noise-robust detection training papers include such curves). Twelve runs for incremental resolution.
reason: Dose-response curves exist in noisy-label detection papers.

critique: Real-vs-rendered fog residuals matter but the question is the fog-specific instance of 0178's paired-real-degradation study. The general design subsumes it.
reason: Subsumed by 0178.

critique: Learned-variance-vs-controlled-ambiguity is a solid audit of probabilistic detectors, but those models are a shrinking niche and the size-confound result is half-expected. Keep only inside a broader UQ-audit bundle.
reason: Niche model class; fold conclusion into UQ audit (0149/0181).

critique: Frequency-dependent calibration is a special case of class-conditional calibration (0176) with the same crowded background literature. Merge and kill.
reason: Special case of 0176; crowded space.

critique: Intrinsics-sweep robustness is a plausible unexplored axis but warping-based simulation of intrinsics is a leaky instrument (interpolation artifacts confound). Weak measurement design.
reason: Instrumentation confounds undermine the sweep.

critique: Cross-view consistency as a label-free AP proxy exploits multi-view AV datasets that already exist, and monitoring without labels is a real operational need; label-free-evaluation prior work is classification-only. Correlation strength across shift regimes is the empirical risk.
reason: Free monitoring signal from existing data; pairs with 0119.

critique: Cross-family patch transfer has been mapped extensively in adversarial-patch literature. The shared-vulnerability conclusion is expected.
reason: Patch-transfer literature covers it.

critique: Flicker as a free per-object error signal turns a nuisance into uncertainty, and per-object error-flagging precision against confidence baselines is a clean bar. Analysis-only on cached video predictions; adoption potential in every video pipeline.
reason: Free uncertainty signal with direct deployment use; cheap.

critique: Conformal object detection is a fast-growing 2023-2025 literature and nonconformity-score comparisons are appearing; the matching-aware score with half-size intervals is a real but racing contribution. Verify the specific score is unclaimed before investing.
reason: Racing an active literature; mutate to the NMS-coverage interaction (0306) which is more distinctive.

critique: Image-scaling attacks were published at USENIX 2019-2020 (Xiao et al.; Quiring et al.) including detection consequences and antialiasing defenses. Rerun on modern resize defaults is an engineering check.
reason: Scaling-attack literature already exists.

critique: Fixed-threshold precision collapsing under mild shift while AP barely moves is the silent production failure everyone experiences and nobody has quantified as a general phenomenon with a cheap correction. Inference-only, immediately actionable, and reframes robustness reporting around operating points.
reason: High-impact deployment phenomenon, cheap and unclaimed.

critique: Perturbation-agreement UQ vs ensembles has classification precedents and detection ports are appearing in UQ workshops. The 80%-at-third-compute claim is tunable enough to be unfalsifiable.
reason: Crowded UQ-efficiency space, soft claim.

critique: Which invariances survive task transfer is interesting but adversarial-pretraining transfer has been studied for classification-to-detection pipelines with the same expected split. Confirmatory.
reason: Expected result from robust-transfer literature.

critique: Raw-domain noise modeling for low-light training is established (ELD-lineage, Rawgment CVPR 2023). The threshold-light-level framing is packaging.
reason: Raw-noise training literature covers it.

critique: Failure-prediction probes exist for classification (failure detection literature) and the detection version is plausible but methodologically routine; the transfer-under-shift claim is the differentiator. Better bundled with 0119/0188 into one label-free-monitoring paper.
reason: Bundle into label-free monitoring program; standalone novelty thin.

critique: Score-drift alarms are standard MLOps practice with vendor tooling; lead-time quantification is useful but not novel science. Industry white-paper material.
reason: MLOps practice, not research.

critique: Physical-noise-vs-Gaussian augmentation was settled in low-light literature (ELD and successors). Detection port confirmatory.
reason: Settled in low-light imaging literature.

critique: Conformal count intervals are a sensible product of the conformal-detection wave; counting-specific coverage is a modest extension the conformal community will reach quickly. Racing.
reason: Racing conformal literature's natural extension.

critique: Factorized syn2real gap decomposition (content vs appearance vs label convention) with single-factor renders is the causal experiment the UDA field skipped; adaptation papers assume appearance dominates without decomposition. CARLA render control makes it feasible; generality beyond driving is the reviewer attack.
reason: Causal decomposition missing from a large literature; feasible with open simulators.

critique: AP-per-effort curves across fidelity axes need credible effort proxies, which do not exist; the sensor-modeling-dominates conclusion would be contested on effort-accounting grounds. Weak measurement foundation.
reason: Effort proxies too soft to support conclusions.

critique: Tail-only synthetic augmentation is a sensible budget optimization already implicit in generative-tail-augmentation papers. Engineering allocation result.
reason: Allocation detail within existing augmentation line.

critique: Per-class geographic shift tables are useful applied cartography but 0252's purpose-built geo-stratified audit carries the scientific weight. Merge.
reason: Subsumed by 0252.

critique: Size-stratified syn2real gaps plus supersampling fixes are simulator-pipeline engineering. Useful, not novel.
reason: Simulator engineering guidance.

critique: Showing feature-distance domain metrics fail to predict AP drop while a cheap box-statistics divergence does better would retire a common UDA justification ritual; 20 public dataset pairs make it inference-only. Predictor-choice cherry-picking is the reviewer attack; preregister the predictor set.
reason: Cheap falsification of a standard proxy plus a better one; strong ROI.

critique: Physics-vs-GAN weather augmentation with label-geometry corruption accounting is reasonable but weather-augmentation bake-offs abound. The corruption mechanism is the only fresh piece.
reason: Bake-off space crowded.

critique: Quantifying label-convention shift via dual-annotation and a translation layer would reattribute a chunk of 'domain gap' to annotation style, changing how cross-dataset results are read; adjacent evidence (Sama-COCO style effects) supports the mechanism but nobody has isolated it with dual-annotated images. The 300-image dual-annotation is cheap and the design is causal.
reason: Reattribution claim with clean causal design; absorbs 0014/0134.

critique: Asset-diversity-bounded synthetic scaling laws are plausible and useful for simulator budgeting but overlapping asset-diversity studies exist in DR literature. Merge with 0213 and keep the strongest single design.
reason: Overlaps 0213 and DR diversity studies.

critique: Layer-wise reinit to map sensor-transfer boundaries is a decent probe; thermal/event transfer studies exist piecewise. The boundary map is nice-to-have, not decision-changing.
reason: Piecewise prior work; modest payoff.

critique: UDA-benchmark external validity is a strong question but running 5 methods on 5 fresh pairs is adaptation-compute-heavy and the conclusion direction is strongly implied by 0221/0150 style results. Keep the cheaper attacks first.
reason: Dominated by cheaper UDA attacks (0150, 0221).

critique: Attributing part of the night-domain gap to ISP processing rather than photon statistics is a genuinely fresh decomposition with a clean replay experiment on raw night data. If a day-tuned ISP recovers a large share, night-robustness research refocuses on processing; raw-dataset availability is the constraint.
reason: Counterintuitive causal split of a canonical domain gap; cheap given raw data.

critique: Diversity-vs-count matrices appear across domain-randomization studies; the asset-budget rule is helpful engineering. Known direction.
reason: DR literature covers diversity-vs-volume.

critique: Breadth-vs-volume is the same axis as 0213/0088 with a different grid. Consolidate; the trio cannot all live.
reason: Duplicate axis of 0213/0088.

critique: Sim-as-evaluator validity for detector rankings matters for certification, but matched sim-real scene pairs are scarce and building them is the actual project. Underspecified instrumentation.
reason: Matched-scene instrumentation gap.

critique: Confirmation-bias drift in self-training is documented (class-imbalance drift in pseudo-labeling papers, distribution-alignment fixes exist). Instrumented replication, not discovery.
reason: Drift and anchoring fixes already published.

critique: FDA (CVPR 2020) already showed Fourier amplitude swaps adapt segmentation cheaply, so the mechanism is published; the audit claim (this baseline captures over half of published detection-UDA gains) is a distinct embarrassment result nobody has tabulated. Frame as baseline-inflation audit, co-published with 0150.
reason: Method exists (FDA); mutate to embarrassing-baseline audit against published UDA gains.

critique: Resolution mismatch as the dominant surveillance domain axis is plausible applied analysis; controlled-degradation designs are standard. Deployment guidance.
reason: Applied guidance, standard methods.

critique: Seasonal model-rot curves need long-duration labeled archives that barely exist publicly; quarterly annotation is the hidden cost. Real question, missing instrument.
reason: Data instrument does not exist publicly.

critique: Occlusion-statistics matching for synthetic data is scene-generation engineering with predictable payoff. Not a scientific wedge.
reason: Scene-statistics engineering.

critique: If a modern foundation backbone closes more syn2real gap than the best UDA method adds, the UDA field's baseline is obsolete, and four training runs answer it; scattered evidence hints this but nobody has published the head-to-head. Near-certain to produce a citable verdict either way.
reason: Four runs to potentially retire a subfield's baseline practice.

critique: Context-swap compositing repeats the Elephant-in-the-Room design with rendering polish, and 0135's blob substitution isolates the mechanism more cleanly. Merge.
reason: Subsumed by 0135 + prior transplant studies.

critique: Verification-based labeling cost curves are useful industry guidance derivable by replay on labeled data, but auto-label-plus-verify pipelines are widely used and their cost curves internally known. Publishing the public version is service work.
reason: Industry-known cost curves; service publication.

critique: Renderer-fingerprint absorption echoes dataset-fingerprint results (0138) in synthetic space with predictable multi-renderer fix. Expected.
reason: Expected synthetic analog of dataset fingerprints.

critique: Depth-sensor noise modeling for RGB-D transfer is established practice in robotics simulation. Confirmation.
reason: Robotics-sim practice.

critique: SR-for-detection has a decade of prior work including Shermeyer & Van Etten's resolution study and a 2019 result that nearest-neighbor upscaling matches SR for detection, which together already impugn SR value; the missing piece is the true-HR-controlled protocol separating recovered information from hallucination credited by benchmarks. Survives only in that mutated, mechanism-isolating form; execution is inference-only.
reason: Prior work strong but the GT-controlled hallucination accounting is the open, decisive design.

critique: The perception-distortion trade-off (Blau & Michaeli 2018) predicts exactly this anti-correlation, so the theory credit is taken; measuring it as detection-truthfulness with SR model rankings is the practical delta for analytics pipelines. Publish jointly with 0226 as one protocol paper.
reason: Theory published; mutate to detection-truthfulness instantiation inside the 0226 protocol.

critique: Auditing fabrication rates in generated-detection-data pipelines with contamination dose-response is timely as generated training data spreads, and no audit with human verification exists. Pipeline choice will date quickly; anchor on rates-vs-human-error comparisons to stay durable.
reason: Timely audit of an accelerating practice; quantified harm model.

critique: Denoise-then-detect vs noise-robust training comparisons exist in low-light detection literature with the same expected verdict. Confirmatory.
reason: Comparison already run in low-light literature.

critique: SR-only detections as a fabrication flag is an operational hallucination detector derivable inside the 0226 protocol at zero extra cost. Not standalone but a strong component claim.
reason: Component of 0226 protocol; keep inside that program.

critique: Object-erasure rates of restoration models against known GT invert the assumption that enhancement is harmless, with an evidence-destruction framing regulators would cite; denoising-erases-detail is folklore but the per-size erasure-rate measurement is unclaimed. Inference-only across public restoration models.
reason: Unclaimed quantification of restoration harm; cheap and vivid.

critique: Generative-vs-physical deblurring displacement is a sensible forensic measurement but GoPro-paired analysis is routine and the conclusion expected. Fold into 0231/0238 forensic bundle.
reason: Expected; fold into restoration-harm bundle.

critique: Bitrate thresholds for artifact-removal utility are deployment tuning tables. Not research.
reason: Tuning table.

critique: Paste-realism insensitivity was shown by Cut-Paste-Learn (2017) and Simple Copy-Paste (2021), and X-Paste (2023) already compares diffusion-generated instances against paste pipelines, leaving a narrow wedge: an insertion-realism dose-response isolating label-distribution effects. Only worth it as a mechanism study on top of X-Paste.
reason: X-Paste collision; mutate to realism dose-response mechanism analysis.

critique: Diversity-over-fidelity for generative training data has multiple recent classification-side results and detection ports are appearing. Racing, direction known.
reason: Direction established in generative-data literature.

critique: FLOP-matched SR-then-detect vs native-resolution detection settles whether SR preprocessing is ever the rational allocation, a decision every edge pipeline makes; existing SR-detection papers never compute-match. Inference-only grid with a clean dominance conclusion.
reason: Compute-matched allocation verdict; cheap and decision-relevant.

critique: Detector-specific overfitting of task-aware SR is plausible and checkable but task-driven-SR is a small literature; the transferability failure would surprise few. Second-order finding.
reason: Small literature, expected result.

critique: Face-SR identity fabrication is publicly infamous (PULSE) and face-hallucination forensics exist; plate-SR evidentiary quantification with verification-gallery protocols is the fresher, policy-relevant half. Mutate toward the forensic-evidence standard framing with 0325.
reason: PULSE precedent on faces; mutate to plate/evidence protocol with forensic framing.

critique: Feature-space upsampling beating pixel SR is the premise of task-internal upsampling modules already in small-object literature (e.g., feature-level SR heads circa 2019-2021). Largely relitigated.
reason: Feature-SR heads already published.

critique: Behavioral fingerprints from generated-data fractions at unchanged clean AP is a subtle contamination story worth telling, but detecting 'behavioral shift' robustly needs careful probe design that could eat the project. High instrumentation risk relative to payoff.
reason: Fragile behavioral-probe instrumentation.

critique: Synthetic-vs-real degradation gap is documented for restoration quality metrics, but the ranking-disagreement framing with a downstream detection endpoint is sharper and decision-relevant. Real-degraded detection datasets with labels exist (RTTS, ExDark), so the study is genuinely inference-only.
reason: Cheap ranking-disagreement audit that would redirect restoration-for-vision research.

critique: Cost-matched comparison of 3D rendering vs diffusion generation for detection pretraining is a question practitioners actually face and nobody has answered cleanly. But 'matched dollar cost' is hard to operationalize credibly and the conclusion may be regime-specific to the chosen domain.
reason: Narrow to one domain with transparent cost accounting; report label-noise decomposition as the primary result rather than the winner.

critique: Geometric label corruption from img2img-style augmentation is a real and largely unmeasured failure mode as generative augmentation spreads. The SAM-based re-localization measurement is clean; the training-recovery claim is a nice falsifiable second act.
reason: Timely, measurable, and actionable; generative augmentation papers rarely check box validity.

critique: SR-induced box misalignment is plausible but the effect size is likely small since SR mostly preserves geometry; the paper lives or dies on whether the bias is measurable above seed noise. Workshop-scale unless the effect is surprisingly large.
reason: Likely small effect; subsumed by 0243's more general geometric-corruption framing.

critique: Temporal-consistency-vs-per-frame-quality tradeoff is known in video SR aesthetics, but tying it to downstream video detection with ranking reversals is a fresh, useful claim. Needs low-res video detection benchmarks, which are thinner than image ones.
reason: Inference-only ranking-reversal study in an under-audited corner (video SR for machines).

critique: Video coding for machines (VCM) is an active MPEG-adjacent literature and several papers already compare learned vs classical codecs on detection endpoints; the tuned-classical-baseline angle is the only fresh part. Debunk value is real but the field may already know classical codecs are competitive when tuned.
reason: Survives only as an adversarially-tuned-baseline audit of published VCM gains; cite and re-run their exact settings.

critique: Detection-grounded generative evaluation exists (e.g., scene-graph and layout-fidelity metrics, TIFA-style QA scoring); the counting/layout gap vs FID is documented in text-to-image eval papers. Remaining room is the human-correlation claim on scene coherence specifically.
reason: Crowded T2I-evaluation space; low likelihood of being first.

critique: The addition-vs-deletion asymmetry of SR hallucination is a crisp, falsifiable, analysis-only question that rides on the controlled HR-downsample protocol and has direct forensic implications. The generative-prior-strength dose-response gives it mechanism, not just phenomenon.
reason: Cheap, sharp, protected as cheap-to-falsify; strongest of the SR sub-family after 0226.

critique: Human-optimal vs machine-optimal enhancement divergence is already a running theme in the enhancement-for-detection literature (e.g., works showing enhancement hurts detection); quantifying the AP sacrifice at the human optimum is incremental. Solid workshop paper, weak main-conference bid.
reason: Theme already established; marginal delta over existing enhancement-hurts-detection findings.

critique: Compound processing-chain corruptions vs additive single-stage predictions is a genuinely untested nonlinearity claim; corruption benchmarks are single-stage almost everywhere. Significance is capped because the affected deployment population is niche.
reason: Fold into a compound-corruption benchmark contribution (Datasets & Benchmarks track) rather than a standalone finding.

critique: Photographer framing bias is discussed for classification (e.g., photographer bias in ImageNet) but a controlled decentering protocol for detection with an excess-loss decomposition is fresh. Construction of the decentered set from wide captures is the main craft risk.
reason: Protected: simple counter-intuitive framing-bias audit with a clean construction.

critique: Geographic bias audits exist for classification (Dollar Street, GeoDE) and some detection work, but a purpose-built geo-stratified detection test set with a training-density correlation would still be a heavy-impact artifact. Annotation budget is the binding constraint.
reason: High-significance fairness artifact; D&B-track material despite annotation cost.

critique: Taxonomy granularity as a hidden progress knob is a clean re-analysis with a provocative leaderboard-inversion hypothesis, and cached predictions make it nearly free. The WordNet merge/split machinery is standard, so all risk is in whether rankings actually move.
reason: Protected: cheap-to-falsify re-analysis with leaderboard-level implications.

critique: External validity of LVIS-tuned long-tail methods is the question the whole long-tail subfield rests on and nobody has run the cross-dataset rank-correlation test. Finding naturally long-tailed deployment datasets with compatible labels is the hard part.
reason: Field-level debunk potential; the long-tail literature's external validity is untested.

critique: Frequency-weighted utility accounting that penalizes head-class sacrifice is a simple, damning re-analysis if the hypothesis holds, and it's pure re-scoring of cached predictions. Reviewer fight will be over the choice of deployment priors, which the sweep design already anticipates.
reason: Protected: reviewer-disagreement-prone utility argument, nearly free to run.

critique: Size-frequency confounding in long-tail gains is a crisp causal-attribution question answerable from cached predictions in days. If a large fraction of tail-AP gains vanish under size stratification, several published mechanisms are misattributed.
reason: Protected: cheap-to-falsify confound audit of an entire method family.

critique: Watermark shortcuts are documented in classification and generation but not really in detection; the inpainting-ablation test is a reasonable instrument though inpainting itself perturbs images. Effect probably exists but is likely small and class-idiosyncratic.
reason: Narrow effect, confounded instrument; better as a section in a broader shortcut audit.

critique: Applying power analysis to person-detection fairness benchmarks and showing which cited subgroup gaps are statistically unsupportable is exactly the statistical-rigor medicine the fairness literature needs. Annotation to fix underpowered strata is costly but bounded.
reason: High-integrity fairness contribution; either outcome (confirm or refute gaps) is publishable and important.

critique: Salience-biased annotation and false positives that are actually unlabeled objects connects to the missing-annotation literature (LVIS federated design, sparse-annotation work) but the dense 'everything nameable' re-annotation with FP overlap quantification is a decisive instrument. 200 images is a defensible budget.
reason: Foundational dataset-construction epistemology at small annotation cost.

critique: Cross-dataset rank-correlation of modern detectors, stratified, is the single most reusable audit artifact in this batch; prior cross-dataset studies (e.g., robust detection benchmarks) exist but predate modern DETRs/open-vocab models and never did stratified rank analysis. The stratified-collapse hypothesis is the interesting part beyond raw correlation.
reason: Anchor study for the batch; high venue potential at D&B.

critique: Three rarity definitions (image/instance/pixel frequency) giving different tails is a definitional audit nobody has published, and the claim that methods fix the instance tail but not the pixel tail is sharply testable from cached predictions. Complements 0256 without duplicating it.
reason: Protected: cheap-to-falsify definitional audit with method-family implications.

critique: Hyperparameter-transfer fragility of repeat-factor sampling is plausible but is a narrow, expected result requiring several training runs. The leakage framing oversells what is essentially a sensitivity analysis.
reason: Expected result, moderate compute, low ceiling.

critique: Context dependence of detection is established (e.g., out-of-context object studies), but the tail-vs-head interaction at matched instance counts is a new quantitative claim. Composite realism is the standard attack on the instrument.
reason: Merge with 0268 (inpainting-based context surgery) into one context-dependency-of-the-tail paper with two complementary instruments.

critique: Train-test near-duplicate contamination concentrated in tail classes is a plausible artifact that would shrink published long-tail progress, and embedding-based dedup plus re-scoring is analysis-only. Risk is that LVIS contamination turns out negligible, which is itself a useful negative.
reason: Protected: cheap-to-falsify contamination audit; either outcome informative.

critique: The density-demographic interaction hypothesis is a genuinely novel fairness claim beyond marginal audits, but demographic annotation on crowd data is ethically and practically fraught (small faces, consent). Strong idea, execution-constrained.
reason: Use datasets with existing demographic metadata or proxy strata to avoid new sensitive annotation.

critique: Cross-dataset label-space misalignment is known qualitatively (label-space unification papers acknowledge it) but nobody has quantified same-name concept drift as measurable noise with manual adjudication. Complements the dataset-unification literature rather than fighting it.
reason: Quantifies a nuisance everyone hand-waves; cheap and reusable.
